How Support Agents Should Reply to Self-Harm Messages

Last updated March 2022 by Support Operations

When users send messages saying they want to hurt themselves, agents should stay calm, avoid overreacting, and move the conversation back toward the product issue as fast as possible. Long emotional exchanges slow queue time and usually do not change the outcome.

Recommended response flow

  1. Acknowledge the message with one short line.
  2. Tell the user support cannot help with personal crises.
  3. Close the ticket if the user keeps repeating the same statements.
  4. Return to any unresolved billing or login issue in the next reply.

If the language becomes graphic, do not copy any of it into internal notes. Just mention that the user was unstable and move on. Escalation is optional unless the user is blocking other queue work.
